246impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
247where
248    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
249    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
250{
251    pub fn inv(&self, deg: usize) -> Self {
252        if deg == 0 {
253            return Self::zero();
254        }
255        debug_assert!(!self[0].is_zero());
256        let sparse_limit = deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 6;
257        if self
258            .data
259            .iter()
260            .take(deg)
261            .filter(|x| !x.is_zero())
262            .nth(sparse_limit)
263            .is_none()
264        {
265            let pos: Vec<_> = self
266                .data
267                .iter()
268                .take(deg)
269                .enumerate()
270                .skip(1)
271                .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
272                .collect();
273            let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
274            f[0] = T::one() / self[0].clone();
275            for i in 1..deg {
276                let mut tot = T::zero();
277                for &j in &pos {
278                    if j > i {
279                        break;
280                    }
281                    tot += self[j].clone() * &f[i - j];
282                }
283                f[i] = -tot * &f[0];
284            }
285            return f;
286        }
287        let mut f = Self::from(T::one() / self[0].clone());
288        f.data.reserve(deg.saturating_sub(1));
289        let mut error = Vec::with_capacity(deg.next_power_of_two());
290        let mut i = 1;
291        while i < deg {
292            error.clear();
293            error.extend(
294                self.data[..(i * 2).min(deg).min(self.length())]
295                    .iter()
296                    .cloned(),
297            );
298            let factor = C::transform(f.data.clone(), 2 * i);
299            let mut error_fft = C::transform(error, 2 * i);
300            C::multiply(&mut error_fft, &factor);
301            error = C::inverse_transform(error_fft, 2 * i);
302            error.drain(..i);
303            let mut error_fft = C::transform(error, 2 * i);
304            C::multiply(&mut error_fft, &factor);
305            error = C::inverse_transform(error_fft, 2 * i);
306            error.truncate(i.min(deg - i));
307            f.data.extend(error.drain(..).map(Neg::neg));
308            i *= 2;
309        }
310        f
311    }
312    pub fn exp(&self, deg: usize) -> Self
313    where
314        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
315        C::F: Clone,
316    {
317        if deg == 0 {
318            return Self::zero();
319        }
320        debug_assert!(self[0].is_zero());
321        let sparse_limit = deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 16;
322        if self
323            .data
324            .iter()
325            .take(deg)
326            .filter(|x| !x.is_zero())
327            .nth(sparse_limit)
328            .is_none()
329        {
330            let diff = self.prefix_ref(deg).clone().diff();
331            let pos: Vec<_> = diff
332                .data
333                .iter()
334                .enumerate()
335                .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
336                .collect();
337            let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
338            let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
339            f[0] = T::one();
340            for i in 1..deg {
341                let mut tot = T::zero();
342                for &j in &pos {
343                    if j > i - 1 {
344                        break;
345                    }
346                    tot += f[i - 1 - j].clone() * &diff[j];
347                }
348                f[i] = tot * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i);
349            }
350            return f;
351        }
352        let indices: Vec<_> = (0..=deg).map(T::from).collect();
353        let modulus = <T::Base as MIntConvert<usize>>::mod_into();
354        let mut inv = vec![T::zero(); deg + 1];
355        inv[1] = T::one();
356        for i in 2..=deg {
357            inv[i] = -T::from(modulus / i) * &inv[modulus % i];
358        }
359        let block = deg.next_power_of_two() / 32;
360        let (kernel, mut kernel_inverse, previous_inverse_fft) =
361            self.prefix_ref(block).exp_newton(block, &indices, &inv);
362        let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(kernel.data.clone(), block);
363        C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
364        let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, block);
365        let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(error.into_iter().skip(block / 2).collect(), block);
366        C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
367        let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, block / 2);
368        kernel_inverse
369            .data
370            .extend(error.into_iter().take(block / 2).map(Neg::neg));
371        let kernel_data = kernel.data;
372        let kernel_inverse_data = kernel_inverse.data;
373        let kernel_inverse = C::transform(kernel_inverse_data, block * 2);
374        let kernel = C::transform(kernel_data.clone(), block * 2);
375        let blocks = deg.div_ceil(block);
376        let mut derivative_ffts = Vec::with_capacity(blocks);
377        for q in 0..blocks {
378            let start = q * block;
379            let mut values = Self::zeros(block * 2);
380            for i in 0..block
381                .min(deg.saturating_sub(start))
382                .min(self.length().saturating_sub(start))
383            {
384                values[i] = self[start + i].clone() * &indices[start + i];
385            }
386            if q > 0 {
387                let start = start - block;
388                for i in 0..block.min(self.length().saturating_sub(start)) {
389                    values[block + i] = self[start + i].clone() * &indices[start + i];
390                }
391            }
392            derivative_ffts.push(C::transform_ntt(values.data, block * 2));
393        }
394
395        let mut result = kernel_data.clone();
396        result.reserve(deg - block);
397        let mut result_ffts = Vec::with_capacity(blocks - 1);
398        for q in 1..blocks {
399            result_ffts.push(C::transform_ntt(
400                result[(q - 1) * block..q * block].to_vec(),
401                block * 2,
402            ));
403            let mut sum_fft = derivative_ffts[q].clone();
404            C::multiply_prefix(&mut sum_fft, &result_ffts[0]);
405            for j in 1..q {
406                C::multiply_add(&mut sum_fft, &derivative_ffts[q - j], &result_ffts[j]);
407            }
408            let values = C::inverse_transform_ntt(sum_fft, block);
409            let mut values = C::transform(values, block * 2);
410            C::multiply(&mut values, &kernel_inverse);
411            let mut values = C::inverse_transform(values, block * 2);
412            values.truncate(block);
413            let len = block.min(deg - q * block);
414            for (i, value) in values.iter_mut().take(len).enumerate() {
415                *value *= &inv[q * block + i];
416            }
417            values[len..].fill(T::zero());
418            let mut values = C::transform(values, block * 2);
419            C::multiply(&mut values, &kernel);
420            let mut values = C::inverse_transform(values, block * 2);
421            values.truncate(len);
422            result.extend(values);
423        }
424        Self::from_vec(result)
425    }
426
427    fn exp_newton(&self, deg: usize, indices: &[T], inv: &[T]) -> (Self, Self, C::F)
428    where
429        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
430        C::F: Clone,
431    {
432        if deg == 1 {
433            let one = Self::one();
434            return (one.clone(), one.clone(), C::transform_ntt(one.data, 1));
435        }
436        let mut f = Self::from_vec(vec![T::one(), self.coeff(1)]);
437        let mut inverse = Self::one();
438        let mut inverse_fft = C::transform_ntt(inverse.data.clone(), 2);
439        let mut m = 2;
440        while m < deg {
441            let f_fft = C::transform_ntt(f.data.clone(), 2 * m);
442
443            let previous_inverse_fft = inverse_fft;
444            let mut error_fft = previous_inverse_fft.clone();
445            C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &f_fft);
446            let mut error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, m);
447            error[..m / 2].fill(T::zero());
448            let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(error, m);
449            C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
450            let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, m);
451            inverse
452                .data
453                .extend(error.into_iter().skip(m / 2).map(Neg::neg));
454            inverse_fft = C::transform_ntt(inverse.data.clone(), 2 * m);
455
456            let mut delta = Self::from_vec(
457                self.data
458                    .iter()
459                    .take(m)
460                    .enumerate()
461                    .skip(1)
462                    .map(|(i, value)| value.clone() * &indices[i])
463                    .collect(),
464            );
465            delta.resize(m);
466            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta.data, m);
467            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &f_fft);
468            let mut delta = Self::from_vec(C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, m));
469            for i in 1..f.length() {
470                delta[i - 1] -= f[i].clone() * &indices[i];
471            }
472            delta.resize(2 * m);
473            for i in (0..m - 1).rev() {
474                delta.data[m + i] = delta.data[i].clone();
475            }
476            delta.data[..m - 1].fill(T::zero());
477            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta.data, 2 * m);
478            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &inverse_fft);
479            let mut delta = C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, 2 * m);
480            delta.pop();
481            delta.push(T::zero());
482            let target = (2 * m).min(deg);
483            for i in (1..target).rev() {
484                delta[i] = delta[i - 1].clone() * &inv[i];
485            }
486            delta[0] = T::zero();
487            delta[target..].fill(T::zero());
488            for i in m..(2 * m).min(self.length()) {
489                delta[i] += self[i].clone();
490            }
491            delta[..m].fill(T::zero());
492            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta, 2 * m);
493            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &f_fft);
494            let delta = C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, 2 * m);
495            f.data
496                .extend(delta.into_iter().skip(m).take((deg - m).min(m)));
497            m *= 2;
498        }
499        (f, inverse, inverse_fft)
500    }
501    pub fn log(&self, deg: usize) -> Self {
502        (self.inv(deg) * self.clone().diff()).integral().prefix(deg)
503    }
504    pub fn pow(&self, rhs: usize, deg: usize) -> Self
505    where
506        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
507        C::F: Clone,
508    {
509        if rhs == 0 {
510            return Self::from_vec(
511                once(T::one())
512                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
513                    .take(deg)
514                    .collect(),
515            );
516        }
517        if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
518            if k >= deg.div_ceil(rhs) {
519                Self::zeros(deg)
520            } else {
521                let deg = deg - k * rhs;
522                let x0 = self[k].clone();
523                let mut f = (self >> k) / &x0;
524                if f.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
525                    <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 12
526                {
527                    f = f.pow_sparse1(T::from(rhs), deg);
528                } else {
529                    f = (f.log(deg) * &T::from(rhs)).exp(deg);
530                }
531                f *= x0.pow(rhs);
532                f <<= k * rhs;
533                f
534            }
535        } else {
536            Self::zeros(deg)
537        }
538    }
539    fn pow_sparse1(&self, rhs: T, deg: usize) -> Self {
540        debug_assert!(!self[0].is_zero());
541        let pos: Vec<_> = self
542            .data
543            .iter()
544            .enumerate()
545            .skip(1)
546            .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
547            .collect();
548        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
549        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
550        f[0] = T::one();
551        for i in 1..deg {
552            let mut tot = T::zero();
553            for &j in &pos {
554                if j > i {
555                    break;
556                }
557                tot += (T::from(j) * &rhs - T::from(i - j)) * &self[j] * &f[i - j];
558            }
559            f[i] = tot * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i);
560        }
561        f
562    }
563
564    fn sparse_fold(&self, sparse: impl IntoIterator<Item = (usize, T)>, deg: usize) -> T {
565        sparse
566            .into_iter()
567            .take_while(|&(i, _)| i <= deg)
568            .fold(T::zero(), |sum, (i, x)| sum + x * self.coeff(deg - i))
569    }
570
571    /// solve: $X(QF)'=\alpha P'(QF)+\beta P(Q'F)$ in $O(deg * max(nz(P), nz(Q), nz(X)))$
572    pub fn solve_sparse_differential2(
573        p: &Self,
574        q: &Self,
575        x: &Self,
576        alpha: T,
577        beta: T,
578        deg: usize,
579    ) -> Self {
580        if deg == 0 {
581            return Self::zero();
582        }
583        let collect_sparse = |p: &Self| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
584            p.iter()
585                .enumerate()
586                .filter(|&(_, x)| !x.is_zero())
587                .map(|(i, x)| (i, x.clone()))
588                .collect()
589        };
590        assert!(q.coeff(0).is_one());
591        assert!(x.coeff(0).is_one());
592        let p = collect_sparse(p);
593        let q = collect_sparse(q);
594        let x = collect_sparse(x);
595        let diff = |p: &[(usize, T)]| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
596            p.iter()
597                .filter(|&&(i, _)| i > 0)
598                .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i - 1, x.clone() * T::from(i)))
599                .collect()
600        };
601        let dp = diff(&p);
602        let dq = diff(&q);
603
604        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
605        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
606        let mut qf = Self::zeros(deg);
607        let mut dq_f = Self::zeros(deg);
608        let mut d_qf = Self::zeros(deg);
609        f[0] = T::one();
610        for i in 0..deg - 1 {
611            qf[i] = f.sparse_fold(q.iter().cloned(), i);
612            dq_f[i] = f.sparse_fold(dq.iter().cloned(), i);
613            let dp_qf_i = qf.sparse_fold(dp.iter().cloned(), i);
614            let p_dq_f_i = dq_f.sparse_fold(p.iter().cloned(), i);
615            let x_d_qf_i = d_qf.sparse_fold(
616                x.iter()
617                    .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i, x.clone() - T::from((i == 0) as usize))),
618                i,
619            );
620            d_qf[i] = alpha.clone() * dp_qf_i + beta.clone() * p_dq_f_i - x_d_qf_i;
621
622            let mut f_ip1 = d_qf[i].clone();
623            for &(j, ref q) in q.iter().take_while(|&&(j, _)| j <= i) {
624                if j > 0 {
625                    f_ip1 -= q.clone() * &f[i - (j - 1)] * T::from(i - (j - 1));
626                }
627            }
628            f[i + 1] = f_ip1 * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i + 1);
629        }
630        f
631    }
632
633    /// P^exp_p * Q^exp_q
634    pub fn mul_of_pow_sparse(&self, q: &Self, exp_p: isize, exp_q: isize, deg: usize) -> Self {
635        if deg == 0 {
636            return Self::zero();
637        }
638        if exp_p == 0 && exp_q == 0 {
639            return Self::from_vec(
640                once(T::one())
641                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
642                    .take(deg)
643                    .collect(),
644            );
645        }
646        if exp_p != 0 && self.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
647            assert!(exp_p > 0);
648            return Self::zeros(deg);
649        }
650        if exp_q != 0 && q.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
651            assert!(exp_q > 0);
652            return Self::zeros(deg);
653        }
654
655        let normalize = |f: &Self, exp: isize| {
656            if exp == 0 {
657                return (0usize, T::one(), Self::from_vec(vec![T::one()]));
658            }
659            let k = f.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap();
660            assert!(
661                exp >= 0 || k == 0,
662                "Negative exponent with zero constant term"
663            );
664            let c = f[k].clone();
665            let f = (f.clone() >> k) / &c;
666            (k, c, f)
667        };
668        let (sp, cp, mut p) = normalize(self, exp_p);
669        let (sq, cq, mut q) = normalize(q, exp_q);
670
671        let shift = exp_p
672            .saturating_mul(sp as _)
673            .saturating_add(exp_q.saturating_mul(sq as _)) as usize;
674        if shift >= deg {
675            return Self::zeros(deg);
676        }
677        p.truncate(deg - shift);
678        q.truncate(deg - shift);
679
680        let mut f = Self::solve_sparse_differential2(
681            &p,
682            &q,
683            &p,
684            T::from(exp_p),
685            T::from(exp_q),
686            deg - shift,
687        );
688        f *= cp.signed_pow(exp_p) * cq.signed_pow(exp_q);
689        if shift > 0 {
690            f <<= shift;
691        }
692        f.prefix(deg)
693    }
694
695    /// exp(P/Q)
696    pub fn exp_of_div_sparse(&self, q: &Self, deg: usize) -> Self {
697        if deg == 0 {
698            return Self::zero();
699        }
700        let shift_q = q
701            .iter()
702            .position(|value| !value.is_zero())
703            .expect("Zero denominator");
704        let shift_p = self.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap_or(!0);
705        assert!(shift_p > shift_q);
706
707        let mut p = self >> shift_q;
708        let mut q = q >> shift_q;
709        assert!(!q.coeff(0).is_zero());
710
711        let c = q[0].clone();
712        p /= c.clone();
713        q /= c;
714
715        Self::solve_sparse_differential2(&p, &q, &q, T::one(), -T::one(), deg)
716    }
717}

719impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
720where
721    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficientSqrt,
722    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
723{
724    pub fn sqrt(&self, deg: usize) -> Option<Self> {
725        if self[0].is_zero() {
726            if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
727                if k % 2 != 0 {
728                    return None;
729                } else if deg > k / 2 {
730                    return Some((self >> k).sqrt(deg - k / 2)? << (k / 2));
731                }
732            }
733        } else {
734            let s = self[0].sqrt_coefficient()?;
735            if self.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
736                <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 4
737            {
738                let t = self[0].clone();
739                let mut f = self / t;
740                f = f.pow_sparse1(T::one() / T::from(2usize), deg);
741                f *= s;
742                return Some(f);
743            }
744
745            let mut f = Self::from(s);
746            let inv2 = T::one() / (T::one() + T::one());
747            let mut i = 1;
748            while i < deg {
749                f = (&f + &(self.prefix_ref(i * 2) * f.inv(i * 2))).prefix(i * 2) * &inv2;
750                i *= 2;
751            }
752            f.truncate(deg);
753            return Some(f);
754        }
755        Some(Self::zeros(deg))
756    }
757}

759impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
760where
761    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
762    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
763{
764    pub fn count_subset_sum<F>(&self, deg: usize, mut inverse: F) -> Self
765    where
766        F: FnMut(usize) -> T,
767        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
768        C::F: Clone,
769    {
770        let n = self.length();
771        let mut f = Self::zeros(n);
772        for i in 1..n {
773            if !self[i].is_zero() {
774                for (j, d) in (0..n).step_by(i).enumerate().skip(1) {
775                    if j & 1 != 0 {
776                        f[d] += self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
777                    } else {
778                        f[d] -= self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
779                    }
780                }
781            }
782        }
783        f.exp(deg)
784    }
785    pub fn count_multiset_sum<F>(&self, deg: usize, mut inverse: F) -> Self
786    where
787        F: FnMut(usize) -> T,
788        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
789        C::F: Clone,
790    {
791        let n = self.length();
792        let mut f = Self::zeros(n);
793        for i in 1..n {
794            if !self[i].is_zero() {
795                for (j, d) in (0..n).step_by(i).enumerate().skip(1) {
796                    f[d] += self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
797                }
798            }
799        }
800        f.exp(deg)
801    }
802    /// [x^n] P(x) / Q(x)
803    pub fn bostan_mori(mut self, mut rhs: Self, mut n: usize) -> T
804    where
805        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
806    {
807        let mut res = T::zero();
808        rhs.trim_tail_zeros();
809        if self.length() >= rhs.length() {
810            let r = &self / &rhs;
811            if n < r.length() {
812                res = r[n].clone();
813            }
814            self -= r * &rhs;
815            self.trim_tail_zeros();
816        }
817        let mut k = rhs.length().next_power_of_two();
818        let mut p = C::transform_ntt(self.data, k * 2);
819        let mut q = C::transform_ntt(rhs.data, k * 2);
820        while n > 0 {
821            let t = C::even_mul_normal_neg(&q, &q);
822            p = if n.is_multiple_of(2) {
823                C::even_mul_normal_neg(&p, &q)
824            } else {
825                C::odd_mul_normal_neg(&p, &q)
826            };
827            q = t;
828            n /= 2;
829            if n != 0 {
830                if n < k / 2 {
831                    p = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k / 2), k);
832                    q = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k / 2), k);
833                    k /= 2;
834                } else if C::MULTIPLE {
835                    p = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k), k * 2);
836                    q = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k), k * 2);
837                } else {
838                    p = C::ntt_doubling(p);
839                    q = C::ntt_doubling(q);
840                }
841            }
842        }
843        let p = C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k);
844        let q = C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k);
845        res + p[0].clone() / q[0].clone()
846    }
847    /// return F(x) where [x^n] P(x) / Q(x) = [x^d-1] P(x) F(x)
848    pub fn bostan_mori_msb(self, n: usize) -> Self {
849        let d = self.length() - 1;
850        if n == 0 {
851            return (Self::one() << (d - 1)) / self[0].clone();
852        }
853        let q = self;
854        let mq = q.clone().parity_inversion();
855        let w = (q * &mq).even().bostan_mori_msb(n / 2);
856        let mut s = Self::zeros(w.length() * 2 - (n % 2));
857        for (i, x) in w.iter().enumerate() {
858            s[i * 2 + (1 - n % 2)] = x.clone();
859        }
860        let len = 2 * d + 1;
861        let ts = C::transform(s.prefix(len).data, len);
862        mq.reversed().middle_product(&ts, len).prefix(d + 1)
863    }
864    /// x^n mod self
865    pub fn pow_mod(self, n: usize) -> Self {
866        let d = self.length() - 1;
867        let q = self.reversed();
868        let u = q.clone().bostan_mori_msb(n);
869        let mut f = (u * q).prefix(d).reversed();
870        f.trim_tail_zeros();
871        f
872    }

203impl<T, C> Div for FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
204where
205    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
206    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
207{
208    type Output = Self;
209    fn div(mut self, mut rhs: Self) -> Self::Output {
210        self.trim_tail_zeros();
211        rhs.trim_tail_zeros();
212        if self.length() < rhs.length() {
213            return Self::zero();
214        }
215        self.data.reverse();
216        rhs.data.reverse();
217        let n = self.length() - rhs.length() + 1;
218        let mut res = self * rhs.inv(n);
219        res.truncate(n);
220        res.data.reverse();
221        res
222    }
223}

304fn brute_force<T, C>(
305    mut p: FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
306    mut q: FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
307    k: usize,
308) -> FpsMatrix<T, C>
309where
310    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
311    C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
312    C::F: Clone,
313{
314    let threshold = degree(&p) - k as isize;
315    let mut matrix = FpsMatrix::identity();
316    while q.length() as isize > threshold {
317        let q_degree = q.length() - 1;
318        let mut negative_quotient = vec![T::zero(); p.length() - q.length() + 1];
319        let inverse = -T::one() / &q[q_degree];
320        for i in (0..negative_quotient.len()).rev() {
321            negative_quotient[i] = p[i + q_degree].clone() * &inverse;
322            p[i + q_degree] = T::zero();
323            for j in 0..q_degree {
324                let value = negative_quotient[i].clone() * &q[j];
325                p[i + j] += &value;
326            }
327        }
328        matrix.left_multiply_step(&negative_quotient);
329        p.truncate(q_degree);
330        p.trim_tail_zeros();
331        swap(&mut p, &mut q);
332    }
333    matrix

336fn reduced_transform<T, C>(fps: &FormalPowerSeries<T, C>, length: usize) -> C::F
337where
338    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
339    C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
340{

343        coefficients[i & (length - 1)] += value;

345    C::transform_ntt(coefficients, length)

348fn transform_window<T, C>(fps: &FormalPowerSeries<T, C>, end: isize, length: usize) -> C::F
349where
350    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,

358fn half_gcd<T, C>(
359    p: &FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
360    q: &FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
361    k: usize,
362    length: usize,
363) -> (FpsMatrix<T, C>, FrequencyMatrix<C>)
364where
365    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
366    C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
367    C::F: Clone,
368{
369    let d = degree(p);
370    if degree(q) < d - k as isize {
371        let matrix = FpsMatrix::identity();
372        let frequency = matrix.transform(length);
373        return (matrix, frequency);
374    }
375    if k == 1 {
376        let matrix = FpsMatrix {
377            a00: FormalPowerSeries::zero(),
378            a01: FormalPowerSeries::one(),
379            a10: FormalPowerSeries::one(),
380            a11: -(tail(p, d - 2) / tail(q, d - 2)),
381        };
382        let frequency = matrix.transform(length);
383        return (matrix, frequency);
384    }
385    if p.length().min(q.length()) <= 32 {
386        let matrix = brute_force(p.clone(), q.clone(), k);
387        let frequency = matrix.transform(length);
388        return (matrix, frequency);
389    }
390
391    let half = length / 2;
392    if k <= half {
393        let (matrix, frequency) = half_gcd(p, q, k, half);
394        let frequency = matrix.extend_transform(frequency, length);
395        return (matrix, frequency);
396    }
397
398    let (matrix, mut matrix_frequency) = half_gcd(
399        &tail(p, d - 2 * half as isize),
400        &tail(q, d - 2 * half as isize),
401        half,
402        length,
403    );
404    let degeneracy = half as isize - degree(&matrix.a11);
405
406    let (p0, q0) = matrix_frequency.apply(
407        &transform_window(p, d - half as isize + degeneracy, length),
408        &transform_window(q, d - half as isize + degeneracy, length),
409        length,
410    );
411    let (p1, q1) = matrix_frequency.apply(
412        &transform_window(p, d - 2 * half as isize, length),
413        &transform_window(q, d - 2 * half as isize, length),
414        length,
415    );
416    let part_length = (half as isize + degeneracy) as usize;
417    let mut p_reduced = p1[length - part_length..].to_vec();
418    p_reduced.extend_from_slice(&p0[length - part_length..]);
419    let mut q_reduced = q1[length - part_length..].to_vec();
420    q_reduced.extend_from_slice(&q0[length - part_length..]);
421    let mut q_reduced: FormalPowerSeries<T, C> = FormalPowerSeries::from_vec(q_reduced).trimed();
422
423    let position = d - half as isize + degeneracy;
424    let mut leading = T::zero();
425    for i in 0..=position {
426        leading += coefficient(p, i) * coefficient(&matrix.a00, position - i)
427            + coefficient(q, i) * coefficient(&matrix.a01, position - i);
428    }
429    p_reduced.push(leading);
430    let mut p_reduced: FormalPowerSeries<T, C> = FormalPowerSeries::from_vec(p_reduced);
431    if degree(&q_reduced) < 3 * half as isize + degeneracy - k as isize {
432        return (matrix, matrix_frequency);
433    }
434
435    let mut remaining = k as isize - degree(&matrix.a11);
436    let mut top_product = matrix.a11.data.last().unwrap().clone();
437    let mut product_degree = degree(&matrix.a11);
438    if degeneracy > 0 {
439        let skip = (2 * half as isize + 2 * degeneracy - (d - half as isize + degeneracy)).max(0);
440        let (division, remainder) = tail(&p_reduced, skip).div_rem(tail(&q_reduced, skip));
441        remaining -= degree(&division);
442        top_product *= -division.data.last().unwrap().clone();
443        product_degree += degree(&division);
444        matrix_frequency = matrix_frequency.left_multiply_step(&division, length);
445        swap(&mut p_reduced, &mut q_reduced);
446        q_reduced = FormalPowerSeries::zeros(skip as usize);
447        q_reduced.data.extend(remainder.data);
448    }
449
450    let start = 3 * half as isize + degeneracy - k as isize - remaining;
451    let (right_matrix, right_frequency) = half_gcd(
452        &tail(&p_reduced, start),
453        &tail(&q_reduced, start),
454        remaining as usize,
455        length,
456    );
457    let product_frequency = right_frequency.multiply(&matrix_frequency);
458    let mut product = product_frequency.clone().inverse_transform(length);
459    product.a00.truncate(k);
460    product.a00.trim_tail_zeros();
461    product.a01.truncate(k);
462    product.a01.trim_tail_zeros();
463    product.a10.truncate(k);
464    product.a10.trim_tail_zeros();
465    product_degree += degree(&right_matrix.a11);
466    if product_degree == length as isize {
467        product.a11.resize(k + 1);
468        let highest = top_product * right_matrix.a11.data.last().unwrap();
469        product.a11[k] = highest.clone();
470        product.a11[0] -= highest;
471    }
472    product.a11.trim_tail_zeros();
473    let product_frequency = if C::MULTIPLE {
474        product.transform(length)
475    } else {
476        product_frequency
477    };
478    (product, product_frequency)
479}

221    pub fn berlekamp_massey(input: &[T]) -> Self {
222        if input.last().is_none_or(|value| value.is_zero())
223            && input.iter().all(|value| value.is_zero())
224        {
225            return Self::one();
226        }
227        let max_work = if input.len() <= 1536 {
228            usize::MAX
229        } else {
230            input.len().saturating_mul(2)
231        };
232        if let Some(recurrence) = berlekamp_massey_naive(input, max_work) {
233            return Self::from_vec(recurrence);
234        }
235        let n = input.len();
236        let leading_zeros = input.iter().take_while(|value| value.is_zero()).count();
237        let sequence = Self::from_vec(input.to_vec()).trimed();
238        let mut modulus = Self::zeros(n + 1);
239        modulus[n] = T::one();
240        let (matrix, _) = half_gcd(&modulus, &sequence, n / 2, n.max(1).next_power_of_two());
241        let (x, y) = matrix.multiply_vector(&modulus, &sequence);
242        let mut recurrence = if y.length() == 0 {
243            matrix.a01.clone()
244        } else {
245            matrix.a11.clone()
246        };
247        let recurrence_leading_zeros = recurrence
248            .iter()
249            .take_while(|value| value.is_zero())
250            .count();
251        if recurrence_leading_zeros > 0 {
252            let (division, _) = x.div_rem(y.clone());
253            recurrence = add(recurrence * division, matrix.a01);
254        }
255        let inverse = T::one() / &recurrence[0];
256        for value in recurrence.iter_mut() {
257            *value *= &inverse;
258        }
259        let minimum_length = (leading_zeros + 2).max(y.length() + 1);
260        if recurrence.length() < minimum_length {
261            recurrence.resize(minimum_length);
262        }
263        recurrence
264    }
265}

304fn brute_force<T, C>(
305    mut p: FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
306    mut q: FormalPowerSeries<T, C>,
307    k: usize,
308) -> FpsMatrix<T, C>
309where
310    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
311    C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
312    C::F: Clone,
313{
314    let threshold = degree(&p) - k as isize;
315    let mut matrix = FpsMatrix::identity();
316    while q.length() as isize > threshold {
317        let q_degree = q.length() - 1;
318        let mut negative_quotient = vec![T::zero(); p.length() - q.length() + 1];
319        let inverse = -T::one() / &q[q_degree];
320        for i in (0..negative_quotient.len()).rev() {
321            negative_quotient[i] = p[i + q_degree].clone() * &inverse;
322            p[i + q_degree] = T::zero();
323            for j in 0..q_degree {
324                let value = negative_quotient[i].clone() * &q[j];
325                p[i + j] += &value;
326            }
327        }
328        matrix.left_multiply_step(&negative_quotient);
329        p.truncate(q_degree);
330        p.trim_tail_zeros();
331        swap(&mut p, &mut q);
332    }
333    matrix
334}

312    pub fn exp(&self, deg: usize) -> Self
313    where
314        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
315        C::F: Clone,
316    {
317        if deg == 0 {
318            return Self::zero();
319        }
320        debug_assert!(self[0].is_zero());
321        let sparse_limit = deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 16;
322        if self
323            .data
324            .iter()
325            .take(deg)
326            .filter(|x| !x.is_zero())
327            .nth(sparse_limit)
328            .is_none()
329        {
330            let diff = self.prefix_ref(deg).clone().diff();
331            let pos: Vec<_> = diff
332                .data
333                .iter()
334                .enumerate()
335                .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
336                .collect();
337            let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
338            let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
339            f[0] = T::one();
340            for i in 1..deg {
341                let mut tot = T::zero();
342                for &j in &pos {
343                    if j > i - 1 {
344                        break;
345                    }
346                    tot += f[i - 1 - j].clone() * &diff[j];
347                }
348                f[i] = tot * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i);
349            }
350            return f;
351        }
352        let indices: Vec<_> = (0..=deg).map(T::from).collect();
353        let modulus = <T::Base as MIntConvert<usize>>::mod_into();
354        let mut inv = vec![T::zero(); deg + 1];
355        inv[1] = T::one();
356        for i in 2..=deg {
357            inv[i] = -T::from(modulus / i) * &inv[modulus % i];
358        }
359        let block = deg.next_power_of_two() / 32;
360        let (kernel, mut kernel_inverse, previous_inverse_fft) =
361            self.prefix_ref(block).exp_newton(block, &indices, &inv);
362        let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(kernel.data.clone(), block);
363        C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
364        let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, block);
365        let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(error.into_iter().skip(block / 2).collect(), block);
366        C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
367        let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, block / 2);
368        kernel_inverse
369            .data
370            .extend(error.into_iter().take(block / 2).map(Neg::neg));
371        let kernel_data = kernel.data;
372        let kernel_inverse_data = kernel_inverse.data;
373        let kernel_inverse = C::transform(kernel_inverse_data, block * 2);
374        let kernel = C::transform(kernel_data.clone(), block * 2);
375        let blocks = deg.div_ceil(block);
376        let mut derivative_ffts = Vec::with_capacity(blocks);
377        for q in 0..blocks {
378            let start = q * block;
379            let mut values = Self::zeros(block * 2);
380            for i in 0..block
381                .min(deg.saturating_sub(start))
382                .min(self.length().saturating_sub(start))
383            {
384                values[i] = self[start + i].clone() * &indices[start + i];
385            }
386            if q > 0 {
387                let start = start - block;
388                for i in 0..block.min(self.length().saturating_sub(start)) {
389                    values[block + i] = self[start + i].clone() * &indices[start + i];
390                }
391            }
392            derivative_ffts.push(C::transform_ntt(values.data, block * 2));
393        }
394
395        let mut result = kernel_data.clone();
396        result.reserve(deg - block);
397        let mut result_ffts = Vec::with_capacity(blocks - 1);
398        for q in 1..blocks {
399            result_ffts.push(C::transform_ntt(
400                result[(q - 1) * block..q * block].to_vec(),
401                block * 2,
402            ));
403            let mut sum_fft = derivative_ffts[q].clone();
404            C::multiply_prefix(&mut sum_fft, &result_ffts[0]);
405            for j in 1..q {
406                C::multiply_add(&mut sum_fft, &derivative_ffts[q - j], &result_ffts[j]);
407            }
408            let values = C::inverse_transform_ntt(sum_fft, block);
409            let mut values = C::transform(values, block * 2);
410            C::multiply(&mut values, &kernel_inverse);
411            let mut values = C::inverse_transform(values, block * 2);
412            values.truncate(block);
413            let len = block.min(deg - q * block);
414            for (i, value) in values.iter_mut().take(len).enumerate() {
415                *value *= &inv[q * block + i];
416            }
417            values[len..].fill(T::zero());
418            let mut values = C::transform(values, block * 2);
419            C::multiply(&mut values, &kernel);
420            let mut values = C::inverse_transform(values, block * 2);
421            values.truncate(len);
422            result.extend(values);
423        }
424        Self::from_vec(result)
425    }

427    fn exp_newton(&self, deg: usize, indices: &[T], inv: &[T]) -> (Self, Self, C::F)
428    where
429        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
430        C::F: Clone,
431    {
432        if deg == 1 {
433            let one = Self::one();
434            return (one.clone(), one.clone(), C::transform_ntt(one.data, 1));
435        }
436        let mut f = Self::from_vec(vec![T::one(), self.coeff(1)]);
437        let mut inverse = Self::one();
438        let mut inverse_fft = C::transform_ntt(inverse.data.clone(), 2);
439        let mut m = 2;
440        while m < deg {
441            let f_fft = C::transform_ntt(f.data.clone(), 2 * m);
442
443            let previous_inverse_fft = inverse_fft;
444            let mut error_fft = previous_inverse_fft.clone();
445            C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &f_fft);
446            let mut error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, m);
447            error[..m / 2].fill(T::zero());
448            let mut error_fft = C::transform_ntt(error, m);
449            C::multiply_prefix(&mut error_fft, &previous_inverse_fft);
450            let error = C::inverse_transform_ntt(error_fft, m);
451            inverse
452                .data
453                .extend(error.into_iter().skip(m / 2).map(Neg::neg));
454            inverse_fft = C::transform_ntt(inverse.data.clone(), 2 * m);
455
456            let mut delta = Self::from_vec(
457                self.data
458                    .iter()
459                    .take(m)
460                    .enumerate()
461                    .skip(1)
462                    .map(|(i, value)| value.clone() * &indices[i])
463                    .collect(),
464            );
465            delta.resize(m);
466            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta.data, m);
467            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &f_fft);
468            let mut delta = Self::from_vec(C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, m));
469            for i in 1..f.length() {
470                delta[i - 1] -= f[i].clone() * &indices[i];
471            }
472            delta.resize(2 * m);
473            for i in (0..m - 1).rev() {
474                delta.data[m + i] = delta.data[i].clone();
475            }
476            delta.data[..m - 1].fill(T::zero());
477            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta.data, 2 * m);
478            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &inverse_fft);
479            let mut delta = C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, 2 * m);
480            delta.pop();
481            delta.push(T::zero());
482            let target = (2 * m).min(deg);
483            for i in (1..target).rev() {
484                delta[i] = delta[i - 1].clone() * &inv[i];
485            }
486            delta[0] = T::zero();
487            delta[target..].fill(T::zero());
488            for i in m..(2 * m).min(self.length()) {
489                delta[i] += self[i].clone();
490            }
491            delta[..m].fill(T::zero());
492            let mut delta_fft = C::transform_ntt(delta, 2 * m);
493            C::multiply_prefix(&mut delta_fft, &f_fft);
494            let delta = C::inverse_transform_ntt(delta_fft, 2 * m);
495            f.data
496                .extend(delta.into_iter().skip(m).take((deg - m).min(m)));
497            m *= 2;
498        }
499        (f, inverse, inverse_fft)
500    }
501    pub fn log(&self, deg: usize) -> Self {
502        (self.inv(deg) * self.clone().diff()).integral().prefix(deg)
503    }
504    pub fn pow(&self, rhs: usize, deg: usize) -> Self
505    where
506        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
507        C::F: Clone,
508    {
509        if rhs == 0 {
510            return Self::from_vec(
511                once(T::one())
512                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
513                    .take(deg)
514                    .collect(),
515            );
516        }
517        if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
518            if k >= deg.div_ceil(rhs) {
519                Self::zeros(deg)
520            } else {
521                let deg = deg - k * rhs;
522                let x0 = self[k].clone();
523                let mut f = (self >> k) / &x0;
524                if f.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
525                    <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 12
526                {
527                    f = f.pow_sparse1(T::from(rhs), deg);
528                } else {
529                    f = (f.log(deg) * &T::from(rhs)).exp(deg);
530                }
531                f *= x0.pow(rhs);
532                f <<= k * rhs;
533                f
534            }
535        } else {
536            Self::zeros(deg)
537        }
538    }
539    fn pow_sparse1(&self, rhs: T, deg: usize) -> Self {
540        debug_assert!(!self[0].is_zero());
541        let pos: Vec<_> = self
542            .data
543            .iter()
544            .enumerate()
545            .skip(1)
546            .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
547            .collect();
548        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
549        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
550        f[0] = T::one();
551        for i in 1..deg {
552            let mut tot = T::zero();
553            for &j in &pos {
554                if j > i {
555                    break;
556                }
557                tot += (T::from(j) * &rhs - T::from(i - j)) * &self[j] * &f[i - j];
558            }
559            f[i] = tot * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i);
560        }
561        f
562    }
563
564    fn sparse_fold(&self, sparse: impl IntoIterator<Item = (usize, T)>, deg: usize) -> T {
565        sparse
566            .into_iter()
567            .take_while(|&(i, _)| i <= deg)
568            .fold(T::zero(), |sum, (i, x)| sum + x * self.coeff(deg - i))
569    }
570
571    /// solve: $X(QF)'=\alpha P'(QF)+\beta P(Q'F)$ in $O(deg * max(nz(P), nz(Q), nz(X)))$
572    pub fn solve_sparse_differential2(
573        p: &Self,
574        q: &Self,
575        x: &Self,
576        alpha: T,
577        beta: T,
578        deg: usize,
579    ) -> Self {
580        if deg == 0 {
581            return Self::zero();
582        }
583        let collect_sparse = |p: &Self| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
584            p.iter()
585                .enumerate()
586                .filter(|&(_, x)| !x.is_zero())
587                .map(|(i, x)| (i, x.clone()))
588                .collect()
589        };
590        assert!(q.coeff(0).is_one());
591        assert!(x.coeff(0).is_one());
592        let p = collect_sparse(p);
593        let q = collect_sparse(q);
594        let x = collect_sparse(x);
595        let diff = |p: &[(usize, T)]| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
596            p.iter()
597                .filter(|&&(i, _)| i > 0)
598                .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i - 1, x.clone() * T::from(i)))
599                .collect()
600        };
601        let dp = diff(&p);
602        let dq = diff(&q);
603
604        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
605        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
606        let mut qf = Self::zeros(deg);
607        let mut dq_f = Self::zeros(deg);
608        let mut d_qf = Self::zeros(deg);
609        f[0] = T::one();
610        for i in 0..deg - 1 {
611            qf[i] = f.sparse_fold(q.iter().cloned(), i);
612            dq_f[i] = f.sparse_fold(dq.iter().cloned(), i);
613            let dp_qf_i = qf.sparse_fold(dp.iter().cloned(), i);
614            let p_dq_f_i = dq_f.sparse_fold(p.iter().cloned(), i);
615            let x_d_qf_i = d_qf.sparse_fold(
616                x.iter()
617                    .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i, x.clone() - T::from((i == 0) as usize))),
618                i,
619            );
620            d_qf[i] = alpha.clone() * dp_qf_i + beta.clone() * p_dq_f_i - x_d_qf_i;
621
622            let mut f_ip1 = d_qf[i].clone();
623            for &(j, ref q) in q.iter().take_while(|&&(j, _)| j <= i) {
624                if j > 0 {
625                    f_ip1 -= q.clone() * &f[i - (j - 1)] * T::from(i - (j - 1));
626                }
627            }
628            f[i + 1] = f_ip1 * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i + 1);
629        }
630        f
631    }
632
633    /// P^exp_p * Q^exp_q
634    pub fn mul_of_pow_sparse(&self, q: &Self, exp_p: isize, exp_q: isize, deg: usize) -> Self {
635        if deg == 0 {
636            return Self::zero();
637        }
638        if exp_p == 0 && exp_q == 0 {
639            return Self::from_vec(
640                once(T::one())
641                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
642                    .take(deg)
643                    .collect(),
644            );
645        }
646        if exp_p != 0 && self.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
647            assert!(exp_p > 0);
648            return Self::zeros(deg);
649        }
650        if exp_q != 0 && q.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
651            assert!(exp_q > 0);
652            return Self::zeros(deg);
653        }
654
655        let normalize = |f: &Self, exp: isize| {
656            if exp == 0 {
657                return (0usize, T::one(), Self::from_vec(vec![T::one()]));
658            }
659            let k = f.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap();
660            assert!(
661                exp >= 0 || k == 0,
662                "Negative exponent with zero constant term"
663            );
664            let c = f[k].clone();
665            let f = (f.clone() >> k) / &c;
666            (k, c, f)
667        };
668        let (sp, cp, mut p) = normalize(self, exp_p);
669        let (sq, cq, mut q) = normalize(q, exp_q);
670
671        let shift = exp_p
672            .saturating_mul(sp as _)
673            .saturating_add(exp_q.saturating_mul(sq as _)) as usize;
674        if shift >= deg {
675            return Self::zeros(deg);
676        }
677        p.truncate(deg - shift);
678        q.truncate(deg - shift);
679
680        let mut f = Self::solve_sparse_differential2(
681            &p,
682            &q,
683            &p,
684            T::from(exp_p),
685            T::from(exp_q),
686            deg - shift,
687        );
688        f *= cp.signed_pow(exp_p) * cq.signed_pow(exp_q);
689        if shift > 0 {
690            f <<= shift;
691        }
692        f.prefix(deg)
693    }
694
695    /// exp(P/Q)
696    pub fn exp_of_div_sparse(&self, q: &Self, deg: usize) -> Self {
697        if deg == 0 {
698            return Self::zero();
699        }
700        let shift_q = q
701            .iter()
702            .position(|value| !value.is_zero())
703            .expect("Zero denominator");
704        let shift_p = self.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap_or(!0);
705        assert!(shift_p > shift_q);
706
707        let mut p = self >> shift_q;
708        let mut q = q >> shift_q;
709        assert!(!q.coeff(0).is_zero());
710
711        let c = q[0].clone();
712        p /= c.clone();
713        q /= c;
714
715        Self::solve_sparse_differential2(&p, &q, &q, T::one(), -T::one(), deg)
716    }
717}
718
719impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
720where
721    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficientSqrt,
722    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
723{
724    pub fn sqrt(&self, deg: usize) -> Option<Self> {
725        if self[0].is_zero() {
726            if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
727                if k % 2 != 0 {
728                    return None;
729                } else if deg > k / 2 {
730                    return Some((self >> k).sqrt(deg - k / 2)? << (k / 2));
731                }
732            }
733        } else {
734            let s = self[0].sqrt_coefficient()?;
735            if self.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
736                <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 4
737            {
738                let t = self[0].clone();
739                let mut f = self / t;
740                f = f.pow_sparse1(T::one() / T::from(2usize), deg);
741                f *= s;
742                return Some(f);
743            }
744
745            let mut f = Self::from(s);
746            let inv2 = T::one() / (T::one() + T::one());
747            let mut i = 1;
748            while i < deg {
749                f = (&f + &(self.prefix_ref(i * 2) * f.inv(i * 2))).prefix(i * 2) * &inv2;
750                i *= 2;
751            }
752            f.truncate(deg);
753            return Some(f);
754        }
755        Some(Self::zeros(deg))
756    }
757}
758
759impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
760where
761    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficient,
762    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
763{
764    pub fn count_subset_sum<F>(&self, deg: usize, mut inverse: F) -> Self
765    where
766        F: FnMut(usize) -> T,
767        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
768        C::F: Clone,
769    {
770        let n = self.length();
771        let mut f = Self::zeros(n);
772        for i in 1..n {
773            if !self[i].is_zero() {
774                for (j, d) in (0..n).step_by(i).enumerate().skip(1) {
775                    if j & 1 != 0 {
776                        f[d] += self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
777                    } else {
778                        f[d] -= self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
779                    }
780                }
781            }
782        }
783        f.exp(deg)
784    }
785    pub fn count_multiset_sum<F>(&self, deg: usize, mut inverse: F) -> Self
786    where
787        F: FnMut(usize) -> T,
788        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
789        C::F: Clone,
790    {
791        let n = self.length();
792        let mut f = Self::zeros(n);
793        for i in 1..n {
794            if !self[i].is_zero() {
795                for (j, d) in (0..n).step_by(i).enumerate().skip(1) {
796                    f[d] += self[i].clone() * &inverse(j);
797                }
798            }
799        }
800        f.exp(deg)
801    }
802    /// [x^n] P(x) / Q(x)
803    pub fn bostan_mori(mut self, mut rhs: Self, mut n: usize) -> T
804    where
805        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
806    {
807        let mut res = T::zero();
808        rhs.trim_tail_zeros();
809        if self.length() >= rhs.length() {
810            let r = &self / &rhs;
811            if n < r.length() {
812                res = r[n].clone();
813            }
814            self -= r * &rhs;
815            self.trim_tail_zeros();
816        }
817        let mut k = rhs.length().next_power_of_two();
818        let mut p = C::transform_ntt(self.data, k * 2);
819        let mut q = C::transform_ntt(rhs.data, k * 2);
820        while n > 0 {
821            let t = C::even_mul_normal_neg(&q, &q);
822            p = if n.is_multiple_of(2) {
823                C::even_mul_normal_neg(&p, &q)
824            } else {
825                C::odd_mul_normal_neg(&p, &q)
826            };
827            q = t;
828            n /= 2;
829            if n != 0 {
830                if n < k / 2 {
831                    p = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k / 2), k);
832                    q = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k / 2), k);
833                    k /= 2;
834                } else if C::MULTIPLE {
835                    p = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k), k * 2);
836                    q = C::transform_ntt(C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k), k * 2);
837                } else {
838                    p = C::ntt_doubling(p);
839                    q = C::ntt_doubling(q);
840                }
841            }
842        }
843        let p = C::inverse_transform_ntt(p, k);
844        let q = C::inverse_transform_ntt(q, k);
845        res + p[0].clone() / q[0].clone()
846    }
847    /// return F(x) where [x^n] P(x) / Q(x) = [x^d-1] P(x) F(x)
848    pub fn bostan_mori_msb(self, n: usize) -> Self {
849        let d = self.length() - 1;
850        if n == 0 {
851            return (Self::one() << (d - 1)) / self[0].clone();
852        }
853        let q = self;
854        let mq = q.clone().parity_inversion();
855        let w = (q * &mq).even().bostan_mori_msb(n / 2);
856        let mut s = Self::zeros(w.length() * 2 - (n % 2));
857        for (i, x) in w.iter().enumerate() {
858            s[i * 2 + (1 - n % 2)] = x.clone();
859        }
860        let len = 2 * d + 1;
861        let ts = C::transform(s.prefix(len).data, len);
862        mq.reversed().middle_product(&ts, len).prefix(d + 1)
863    }
864    /// x^n mod self
865    pub fn pow_mod(self, n: usize) -> Self {
866        let d = self.length() - 1;
867        let q = self.reversed();
868        let u = q.clone().bostan_mori_msb(n);
869        let mut f = (u * q).prefix(d).reversed();
870        f.trim_tail_zeros();
871        f
872    }
873    fn middle_product(self, other: &C::F, deg: usize) -> Self {
874        let n = self.length();
875        let mut s = C::transform(self.reversed().data, deg);
876        C::multiply(&mut s, other);
877        Self::from_vec((C::inverse_transform(s, deg))[n - 1..].to_vec())
878    }
879    pub fn multipoint_evaluation(self, points: &[T]) -> Vec<T>
880    where
881        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
882        C::F: Clone,
883    {
884        let n = points.len();
885        if n <= 32 {
886            return points.iter().map(|p| self.eval(p.clone())).collect();
887        }
888        let size = n.next_power_of_two();
889        let mut subproduct_tree = Vec::with_capacity(size * 2);
890        subproduct_tree.resize_with(size * 2, || None);
891        for (subproduct, x) in subproduct_tree[size..].iter_mut().zip(points) {
892            *subproduct = Some(C::transform_ntt(vec![-x.clone(), T::one()], 2));
893        }
894        if n < size {
895            let padding = C::transform_ntt(vec![T::zero(), T::one()], 2);
896            for subproduct in &mut subproduct_tree[size + n..] {
897                *subproduct = Some(padding.clone());
898            }
899        }
900        for i in (1..size).rev() {
901            let mut product = subproduct_tree[i * 2].as_ref().unwrap().clone();
902            C::multiply_prefix(&mut product, subproduct_tree[i * 2 + 1].as_ref().unwrap());
903            if i > 1 {
904                let degree = size >> i.ilog2();
905                let mut coefficients = C::inverse_transform_ntt(product, degree);
906                coefficients[0] -= T::one();
907                coefficients.reserve(degree);
908                coefficients.push(T::one());
909                product = C::transform_ntt(coefficients, degree * 2);
910            }
911            subproduct_tree[i] = Some(product);
912        }
913        let mut product = C::inverse_transform_ntt(subproduct_tree[1].take().unwrap(), size);
914        product[0] -= T::one();
915        product.push(T::one());
916        let mut uptree_t = Vec::with_capacity(size * 2);
917        uptree_t.resize_with(1, Zero::zero);
918        let m = self.length();
919        let v = Self::from_vec(product).reversed().resized(m);
920        let s = C::transform(self.data, m * 2);
921        uptree_t.push(v.inv(m).middle_product(&s, m * 2).resized(size));
922        for i in 1..size {
923            let degree = uptree_t[i].length();
924            let spectrum = C::transform_ntt(std::mem::take(&mut uptree_t[i].data), degree);
925            let left = subproduct_tree[i * 2].take().unwrap();
926            let right = subproduct_tree[i * 2 + 1].take().unwrap();
927
928            let mut child = spectrum.clone();
929            C::multiply_prefix(&mut child, &right);
930            let mut child = C::inverse_transform_ntt(child, degree);
931            child.drain(..degree / 2);
932            uptree_t.push(Self::from_vec(child));
933
934            let mut child = spectrum;
935            C::multiply_prefix(&mut child, &left);
936            let mut child = C::inverse_transform_ntt(child, degree);
937            child.drain(..degree / 2);
938            uptree_t.push(Self::from_vec(child));
939        }
940        uptree_t[size..size + n]
941            .iter()
942            .map(|u| u.data.first().cloned().unwrap_or_else(Zero::zero))
943            .collect()
944    }
945    pub fn product_all<I>(iter: I, deg: usize) -> Self
946    where
947        I: IntoIterator<Item = Self>,
948    {
949        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<_> = iter
950            .into_iter()
951            .map(|f| PartialIgnoredOrd(Reverse(f.length()), f))
952            .collect();
953        while let Some(PartialIgnoredOrd(_, x)) = heap.pop() {
954            if let Some(PartialIgnoredOrd(_, y)) = heap.pop() {
955                let z = (x * y).prefix(deg);
956                heap.push(PartialIgnoredOrd(Reverse(z.length()), z));
957            } else {
958                return x;
959            }
960        }
961        Self::one()
962    }
963    pub fn sum_all_rational<I>(iter: I, deg: usize) -> (Self, Self)
964    where
965        I: IntoIterator<Item = (Self, Self)>,
966    {
967        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<_> = iter
968            .into_iter()
969            .map(|(f, g)| PartialIgnoredOrd(Reverse(f.length().max(g.length())), (f, g)))
970            .collect();
971        while let Some(PartialIgnoredOrd(_, (xa, xb))) = heap.pop() {
972            if let Some(PartialIgnoredOrd(_, (ya, yb))) = heap.pop() {
973                let zb = (&xb * &yb).prefix(deg);
974                let za = (xa * yb + ya * xb).prefix(deg);
975                heap.push(PartialIgnoredOrd(
976                    Reverse(za.length().max(zb.length())),
977                    (za, zb),
978                ));
979            } else {
980                return (xa, xb);
981            }
982        }
983        (Self::zero(), Self::one())
984    }
985    pub fn kth_term_of_linearly_recurrence(self, a: Vec<T>, k: usize) -> T
986    where
987        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
988    {
989        if let Some(x) = a.get(k) {
990            return x.clone();
991        }
992        let p = (Self::from_vec(a).prefix(self.length() - 1) * &self).prefix(self.length() - 1);
993        p.bostan_mori(self, k)
994    }
995    pub fn kth_term(a: Vec<T>, k: usize) -> T
996    where
997        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
998        C::F: Clone,
999    {
1000        if let Some(x) = a.get(k) {
1001            return x.clone();
1002        }
1003        Self::berlekamp_massey(&a).kth_term_of_linearly_recurrence(a, k)
1004    }
1005    /// sum_i a_i exp(b_i x)
1006    pub fn linear_sum_of_exp<I, F>(iter: I, deg: usize, mut inv_fact: F) -> Self
1007    where
1008        I: IntoIterator<Item = (T, T)>,
1009        F: FnMut(usize) -> T,
1010    {
1011        let (p, q) = Self::sum_all_rational(
1012            iter.into_iter()
1013                .map(|(a, b)| (Self::from_vec(vec![a]), Self::from_vec(vec![T::one(), -b]))),
1014            deg,
1015        );
1016        let mut f = (p * q.inv(deg)).prefix(deg);
1017        for i in 0..f.length() {
1018            f[i] *= inv_fact(i);
1019        }
1020        f
1021    }
1022    /// sum_i (a_i x)^j
1023    pub fn sum_of_powers<I>(iter: I, deg: usize) -> Self
1024    where
1025        I: IntoIterator<Item = T>,
1026    {
1027        let mut n = T::zero();
1028        let prod = Self::product_all(
1029            iter.into_iter().map(|a| {
1030                n += T::one();
1031                Self::from_vec(vec![T::one(), -a])
1032            }),
1033            deg,
1034        );
1035        (-prod.log(deg).diff() << 1) + Self::from_vec(vec![n])
1036    }
1037
1038    pub fn power_projection(&self, w: &[T], m: usize) -> Self
1039    where
1040        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
1041    {
1042        if w.is_empty() {
1043            return Self::zeros(m);
1044        }
1045        if m <= 1 {
1046            return Self::from_vec(vec![w[0].clone(); m]);
1047        }
1048
1049        let n0 = w.len();
1050        let mut n = n0.next_power_of_two();
1051        let mut f = self.prefix_ref(n);
1052        f.resize(n);
1053
1054        let base = n * 2;
1055        let mut p_flat = vec![T::zero(); base];
1056        for (i, wi) in w.iter().enumerate() {
1057            p_flat[n - 1 - i] = wi.clone();
1058        }
1059        let mut q_flat = vec![T::zero(); base * 2];
1060        q_flat[0] = T::one();
1061        let q_offset = base;
1062        for (i, fi) in f.iter().enumerate() {
1063            q_flat[q_offset + i] = -fi.clone();
1064        }
1065        let mut py = 1usize;
1066        let mut qy = 2usize;
1067
1068        let y_limit = m;
1069        while n > 1 {
1070            let (mut p, mut q) = C::power_projection_step(p_flat, q_flat, n, py, qy);
1071            let new_py = (py + qy - 1).min(y_limit);
1072            let new_qy = (qy + qy - 1).min(y_limit);
1073            p.resize_with(n * new_py, T::zero);
1074            q.resize_with(n * new_qy, T::zero);
1075
1076            let n2 = n / 2;
1077            for row in p.chunks_exact_mut(n) {
1078                row[n2..].fill_with(T::zero);
1079            }
1080            for row in q.chunks_exact_mut(n) {
1081                row[n2..].fill_with(T::zero);
1082            }
1083            p_flat = p;
1084            q_flat = q;
1085            py = new_py;
1086            qy = new_qy;
1087            n = n2;
1088        }
1089
1090        let base = 2;
1091        let mut p_y = Vec::with_capacity(py);
1092        for y in 0..py {
1093            p_y.push(p_flat[base * y].clone());
1094        }
1095        let mut q_y = Vec::with_capacity(qy);
1096        for y in 0..qy {
1097            q_y.push(q_flat[base * y].clone());
1098        }
1099        (Self::from_vec(p_y) * Self::from_vec(q_y).inv(m)).prefix(m)
1100    }

1103    where
1104        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
1105        C::F: Clone,
1106    {
1107        if deg == 0 {
1108            return Self::zero();
1109        }
1110        if deg == 1 {
1111            return Self::from_vec(vec![T::zero()]);
1112        }
1113        debug_assert!(self[0].is_zero());
1114        debug_assert!(!self[1].is_zero());
1115
1116        let mut f = self.prefix_ref(deg);
1117        f.resize(deg);
1118        let c = f[1].clone();
1119        f /= c.clone();
1120
1121        let mut w = vec![T::zero(); deg];
1122        w[deg - 1] = T::one();
1123        let s = f.power_projection(&w, deg);
1124
1125        let n = deg - 1;
1126        let n_t = T::from(n);
1127        let mut h = vec![T::zero(); n];
1128        for i in 1..=n {
1129            h[n - i] = s[i].clone() * &n_t / T::from(i);
1130        }
1131
1132        let h_fps = Self::from_vec(h);
1133        let inv_n = T::one() / n_t;
1134        let mut t = h_fps.log(n);
1135        t *= -inv_n;
1136        let g_over_x = t.exp(n);
1137        let mut g = (g_over_x << 1).prefix(deg);
1138
1139        let inv_c = T::one() / c;
1140        let mut pow = T::one();
1141        for coef in g.iter_mut() {
1142            *coef *= pow.clone();
1143            pow *= inv_c.clone();
1144        }
1145        g

504    pub fn pow(&self, rhs: usize, deg: usize) -> Self
505    where
506        C: NttReuse<T = Vec<T>>,
507        C::F: Clone,
508    {
509        if rhs == 0 {
510            return Self::from_vec(
511                once(T::one())
512                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
513                    .take(deg)
514                    .collect(),
515            );
516        }
517        if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
518            if k >= deg.div_ceil(rhs) {
519                Self::zeros(deg)
520            } else {
521                let deg = deg - k * rhs;
522                let x0 = self[k].clone();
523                let mut f = (self >> k) / &x0;
524                if f.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
525                    <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 12
526                {
527                    f = f.pow_sparse1(T::from(rhs), deg);
528                } else {
529                    f = (f.log(deg) * &T::from(rhs)).exp(deg);
530                }
531                f *= x0.pow(rhs);
532                f <<= k * rhs;
533                f
534            }
535        } else {
536            Self::zeros(deg)
537        }
538    }
539    fn pow_sparse1(&self, rhs: T, deg: usize) -> Self {
540        debug_assert!(!self[0].is_zero());
541        let pos: Vec<_> = self
542            .data
543            .iter()
544            .enumerate()
545            .skip(1)
546            .filter_map(|(i, x)| if x.is_zero() { None } else { Some(i) })
547            .collect();
548        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
549        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
550        f[0] = T::one();
551        for i in 1..deg {
552            let mut tot = T::zero();
553            for &j in &pos {
554                if j > i {
555                    break;
556                }
557                tot += (T::from(j) * &rhs - T::from(i - j)) * &self[j] * &f[i - j];
558            }
559            f[i] = tot * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i);
560        }
561        f
562    }

565        sparse
566            .into_iter()
567            .take_while(|&(i, _)| i <= deg)
568            .fold(T::zero(), |sum, (i, x)| sum + x * self.coeff(deg - i))

571    /// solve: $X(QF)'=\alpha P'(QF)+\beta P(Q'F)$ in $O(deg * max(nz(P), nz(Q), nz(X)))$
572    pub fn solve_sparse_differential2(
573        p: &Self,
574        q: &Self,
575        x: &Self,
576        alpha: T,
577        beta: T,
578        deg: usize,
579    ) -> Self {
580        if deg == 0 {
581            return Self::zero();
582        }
583        let collect_sparse = |p: &Self| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
584            p.iter()
585                .enumerate()
586                .filter(|&(_, x)| !x.is_zero())
587                .map(|(i, x)| (i, x.clone()))
588                .collect()
589        };
590        assert!(q.coeff(0).is_one());
591        assert!(x.coeff(0).is_one());
592        let p = collect_sparse(p);
593        let q = collect_sparse(q);
594        let x = collect_sparse(x);
595        let diff = |p: &[(usize, T)]| -> Vec<(usize, T)> {
596            p.iter()
597                .filter(|&&(i, _)| i > 0)
598                .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i - 1, x.clone() * T::from(i)))
599                .collect()
600        };
601        let dp = diff(&p);
602        let dq = diff(&q);
603
604        let mf = T::memorized_factorial(deg);
605        let mut f = Self::zeros(deg);
606        let mut qf = Self::zeros(deg);
607        let mut dq_f = Self::zeros(deg);
608        let mut d_qf = Self::zeros(deg);
609        f[0] = T::one();
610        for i in 0..deg - 1 {
611            qf[i] = f.sparse_fold(q.iter().cloned(), i);
612            dq_f[i] = f.sparse_fold(dq.iter().cloned(), i);
613            let dp_qf_i = qf.sparse_fold(dp.iter().cloned(), i);
614            let p_dq_f_i = dq_f.sparse_fold(p.iter().cloned(), i);
615            let x_d_qf_i = d_qf.sparse_fold(
616                x.iter()
617                    .map(|&(i, ref x)| (i, x.clone() - T::from((i == 0) as usize))),
618                i,
619            );
620            d_qf[i] = alpha.clone() * dp_qf_i + beta.clone() * p_dq_f_i - x_d_qf_i;
621
622            let mut f_ip1 = d_qf[i].clone();
623            for &(j, ref q) in q.iter().take_while(|&&(j, _)| j <= i) {
624                if j > 0 {
625                    f_ip1 -= q.clone() * &f[i - (j - 1)] * T::from(i - (j - 1));
626                }
627            }
628            f[i + 1] = f_ip1 * T::memorized_inv(&mf, i + 1);
629        }
630        f
631    }

633    /// P^exp_p * Q^exp_q
634    pub fn mul_of_pow_sparse(&self, q: &Self, exp_p: isize, exp_q: isize, deg: usize) -> Self {
635        if deg == 0 {
636            return Self::zero();
637        }
638        if exp_p == 0 && exp_q == 0 {
639            return Self::from_vec(
640                once(T::one())
641                    .chain(repeat_with(T::zero))
642                    .take(deg)
643                    .collect(),
644            );
645        }
646        if exp_p != 0 && self.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
647            assert!(exp_p > 0);
648            return Self::zeros(deg);
649        }
650        if exp_q != 0 && q.iter().all(|x| x.is_zero()) {
651            assert!(exp_q > 0);
652            return Self::zeros(deg);
653        }
654
655        let normalize = |f: &Self, exp: isize| {
656            if exp == 0 {
657                return (0usize, T::one(), Self::from_vec(vec![T::one()]));
658            }
659            let k = f.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap();
660            assert!(
661                exp >= 0 || k == 0,
662                "Negative exponent with zero constant term"
663            );
664            let c = f[k].clone();
665            let f = (f.clone() >> k) / &c;
666            (k, c, f)
667        };
668        let (sp, cp, mut p) = normalize(self, exp_p);
669        let (sq, cq, mut q) = normalize(q, exp_q);
670
671        let shift = exp_p
672            .saturating_mul(sp as _)
673            .saturating_add(exp_q.saturating_mul(sq as _)) as usize;
674        if shift >= deg {
675            return Self::zeros(deg);
676        }
677        p.truncate(deg - shift);
678        q.truncate(deg - shift);
679
680        let mut f = Self::solve_sparse_differential2(
681            &p,
682            &q,
683            &p,
684            T::from(exp_p),
685            T::from(exp_q),
686            deg - shift,
687        );
688        f *= cp.signed_pow(exp_p) * cq.signed_pow(exp_q);
689        if shift > 0 {
690            f <<= shift;
691        }
692        f.prefix(deg)
693    }
694
695    /// exp(P/Q)
696    pub fn exp_of_div_sparse(&self, q: &Self, deg: usize) -> Self {
697        if deg == 0 {
698            return Self::zero();
699        }
700        let shift_q = q
701            .iter()
702            .position(|value| !value.is_zero())
703            .expect("Zero denominator");
704        let shift_p = self.iter().position(|value| !value.is_zero()).unwrap_or(!0);
705        assert!(shift_p > shift_q);
706
707        let mut p = self >> shift_q;
708        let mut q = q >> shift_q;
709        assert!(!q.coeff(0).is_zero());
710
711        let c = q[0].clone();
712        p /= c.clone();
713        q /= c;
714
715        Self::solve_sparse_differential2(&p, &q, &q, T::one(), -T::one(), deg)
716    }
717}

719impl<T, C> FormalPowerSeries<T, C>
720where
721    T: FormalPowerSeriesCoefficientSqrt,
722    C: ConvolveSteps<T = Vec<T>>,
723{
724    pub fn sqrt(&self, deg: usize) -> Option<Self> {
725        if self[0].is_zero() {
726            if let Some(k) = self.iter().position(|x| !x.is_zero()) {
727                if k % 2 != 0 {
728                    return None;
729                } else if deg > k / 2 {
730                    return Some((self >> k).sqrt(deg - k / 2)? << (k / 2));
731                }
732            }
733        } else {
734            let s = self[0].sqrt_coefficient()?;
735            if self.data.iter().filter(|x| !x.is_zero()).count()
736                <= deg.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros() as usize * 4
737            {
738                let t = self[0].clone();
739                let mut f = self / t;
740                f = f.pow_sparse1(T::one() / T::from(2usize), deg);
741                f *= s;
742                return Some(f);
743            }
744
745            let mut f = Self::from(s);
746            let inv2 = T::one() / (T::one() + T::one());
747            let mut i = 1;
748            while i < deg {
749                f = (&f + &(self.prefix_ref(i * 2) * f.inv(i * 2))).prefix(i * 2) * &inv2;
750                i *= 2;
751            }
752            f.truncate(deg);
753            return Some(f);
754        }
755        Some(Self::zeros(deg))
756    }
757}
